en.help_tooltip:
Your Warren will catch some amount of prey over each timeskip, but successful hunting patrols are the most important source of freshkill. You can see what was consumed and caught in the Log below! Freshkill can't be stored endlessly: after four moons prey will rot and will be thrown away. Rabbits under 3 moons with a parent (queen) taking care of them don't need food.

Feeding the Warren is very important, therefore rabbits will be fed before any changes to rank. Hover your mouse over the pile to see the current and needed amount of prey for your Warren!
en.prey_amount_info: Up to %{warrior_amount} rabbits can be fed with this amount of prey.
en.prey_amount_none: The fresh-kill pile is empty, the Warren desperately needs prey!
en.prey_amount_very_low: The fresh-kill pile can't even feed half of the Warren. Hunting patrols should be organized immediately.
en.prey_amount_low: Only half of the Warren can be fed currently. Hunting patrols should be organized.
en.prey_amount_average: Every mouth of the Warren can be fed, but some more prey would not harm.
en.prey_amount_high: The fresh-kill pile is overflowing and the Warren can feast!
en.prey_amount_very_high: Inle has blessed the Warren with plentiful prey and the chief rabbit sends their thanks to Silverpelt.
